predictions.selection_reason: Socket.IO session user check -> determines admin access to plugin installation -> critical authorization boundary
predictions.source_summary: Socket.IO connection handshake session populated from Express session via middleware that validates session cookie and loads session from sessionStore
predictions.sink_summary: Plugin management operations: load installed plugins, search for plugins, install/uninstall plugins via Socket.IO events
predictions.guard_summary: Added admin authorization check prevents non-admin users from accessing plugin installation Socket.IO namespace; session authentication middleware validates session before connection
predictions.risk_pattern: Missing authorization check on Socket.IO plugin management endpoints allowing non-admin users to install/uninstall plugins
predictions.context_summary: Authorization check added to Socket.IO plugin installer namespace to restrict plugin management operations to admin users only
unresolved_facts: Whether the session.user.is_admin property is reliably set and validated across all authentication methods
Whether there are other paths to plugin management that bypass this Socket.IO authorization

top_sast_rules.description: An authorization check exists but evaluates access incorrectly.
top_sast_rules.pattern: cwe-863 incorrect-authorization authorization-check permission-check role-check ownership-check acl-check access-decision bypass
top_sast_rules.remediation: Evaluate authorization from trusted server-side identity and policy state.

top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of CRLF Sequences ('CRLF Injection')
top_sast_rules.description: Untrusted CR or LF characters are not neutralized before use in line-delimited protocol metadata.
top_sast_rules.pattern: cwe-93 crlf-injection carriage-return line-feed newline header response-splitting http-header redirect cookie
top_sast_rules.remediation: Reject CR/LF in protocol metadata and use validating framework APIs.
